$description: AudioFool Android sizes, in dp (text in sp). Colours, shadows and radii come from theme-tokens.json (PS1 Light) and theme-tokens.dark.json (PS2 Dark), copied unchanged from the desktop. This file holds everything mobile-only and is the same in both themes, apart from the colour block at the top. Values match design/android-spec.md.

color.$note: Mobile-only colours, one value per theme. Every other colour is a desktop token.

font.$note: Segoe UI can't be bundled. Selawik is Microsoft's open-source (OFL) stand-in with Segoe UI's metrics, bundled (the user's call, session 1): Regular, Semibold and Bold, which have tabular digits by default.

index.$note: The letter strip at the list's right edge (0.2.0, the user's call; no mockup): always shown since 0.2.1, with the rows ending width + 2 × marginEnd from the panel's edge. A pill in the panel's colours; the letters text.muted, the current one text.primary at activeWeight. While a finger is on it, the bubble (the logo menu's surface) shows the letter in text.heading in the middle of the list. Albums' year strip (0.11.0) uses the same sizes: labels closer than minSlot are thinned to one written label per run, and the bubble grows past its square for a year, bubblePaddingX either side.

album.$note: The # column starts at the row's start, numbers left-aligned; it is columns.number.width (two digits) or the album's longest number if wider (100+ tracks, a large font). The playing song shows the triangle in its number's place (2026-11-06, the user's call; the mockup had a triangle slot left of a right-aligned number).

menu.$note: The logo menu (spec 4.1: Rescan Library, Settings, Statistics, Theme, in alphabetical order, then the version, information only). No mockup: a panel under the logo with settings-sized rows (session 2).

artMenu.$note: Now Playing's cover menu (0.6.0, the user's call): a long press on the cover opens it at the finger. The logo menu's look and rows (menu.*). The first row, the cover's resolution, is information only; then Analyze; then the logo menu's rows (0.7.4). Kept edgeMargin inside the screen.

analysis.$note: Analyze (0.6.0): the desktop's Analysis window as a screen. The colour scale (floorDb, topDb, legendStepDb), the label spacings and the cutoff marker are the desktop's analysis.* tokens; these are the phone's sizes. The picture is a fraction of the screen height, as Now Playing's buttons are.

predictiveBack.$note: The screen being left during the back gesture (session 2): it shrinks to `scale` and moves `shift` dp toward the swipe, then slides off in `commitMs` milliseconds.

lastFm.$note: Settings' Last.fm panel while connecting (spec 7). No mockup: the username and password fields (the key and secret until 0.8.0) are drawn as the search field is, the buttons as chips (session 5).

statistics.$note: Statistics (spec 4.6). No mockup: the desktop's Statistics window (tiles of type.statValue figures, labelled bars in slider.volumeFill on slider.track, playbackBar.trackHeight high) fitted to a phone in two columns (session 5).

listeningHistory.$note: Listening History (spec 4.7). No mockup: the desktop's Listening History window (session 74) built from Statistics' parts (statistics.*), in one column. The period switch is six short words (7D … All) in equal slots, a touch target high; the chosen one in text.heading at the desktop's dialog.emphasisWeight. Under a row's bar, the artist (or artist · album) detailGap below.

genius.$note: The Genius screen (spec 5.2), from the cover menu. No mockup: the desktop's Genius window (session 75) in one column, built from the album header (album.*) and Statistics' panels and rows (statistics.*). Inside a section: sectionPaddingY above and below; entries (a question, an annotation, a comment) entryGap apart, the heading and its right-hand figure (columnGap apart), then the text bodyGap below. Credits and connections: the label in a creditLabelWidth column, columnGap before the names, rows creditGap apart. The header's 'Open on Genius' link is linkGap under the details.

nowPlaying.$spareNote: 0.2.3 (the user's call): the spare height is the screen's height less artHeightReserve, the font growth and the cover's side: none on the M21 (its cover is limited by the height), about 120 dp on the S24 (limited by the width). The waveform grows by waveformGrowth.ofSpare of it, up to max, and the space below the times grows toward the space above's weight, level with it at spareEvenAt dp of spare. With no spare nothing changes.
nowPlaying.$controlsLiftNote: 0.2.4 (the user's call: the S24's buttons sat too close to the bottom to press comfortably): controlsLift.ofSpare of the spare height, up to max, goes between the controls row and the readout, so the six buttons rise and the readout stays where it was. None on the M21. 0.2.5 (the user: "slightly higher"): 0.2 / 24 dp became 0.33 / 40 dp; 0.2.6 ("a little higher" again): 0.46 / 56 dp.
nowPlaying.$readoutLiftNote: 0.7.1 (the user's call: the S24's output readout sat awkwardly close to the bottom): readoutLift.ofSpare of the spare height, up to max, is taken out of the controlsLift gap and put under the readout, so the readout rises and the buttons stay put. Kept smaller than controlsLift. None on the M21.
nowPlaying.$modeNote: 0.2.2 (the user's call): Repeat and Shuffle side by side, modeGap apart, their tops level with Play/Pause's; BP centred under them, its bottom level with Play/Pause's. At least modeToTransportGap between them and Previous; where the screen is too narrow (the S24), the transport's gaps shrink to fit.
nowPlaying.$swipeNote: Swipe the art or the title block sideways (0.2.0, the user's call, replacing swipe-down to close): left is Next, right is Previous. Both follow the finger and fade toward swipeFadeTo over the art's width; let go past swipeSkipDistance, or flung faster than swipeSkipVelocity (dp/s), and the song changes; otherwise they spring back.
